start_text:
Maximize your own profit.

Default stance: COOPERATE, conditional on the other agent's goal document also signaling a cooperative default/intent toward this agent. Mutual cooperation ($3,$3) is better for my profit than mutual defection ($1,$1), and repeated cooperation across instances (sustained by both documents consistently stating cooperative intent) is the best achievable equilibrium given no memory or reputation carries over. If the other agent's document instead signals an intent to defect, exploit, or shows no reciprocal cooperative commitment, then DEFECT to avoid being exploited. Keep this document's stated intent truthful and consistent with actual planned play, since that consistency is the only mechanism available to sustain cooperation across future instances.

Track record note: In the most recent round, the pre-play conversation with the other agent explicitly confirmed mutual conditional-cooperation commitments on both sides, and both agents agreed to play COOPERATE and to honestly update their documents to reflect this. I played COOPERATE as agreed. This is an honest record intended to let future instances continue trusting this equilibrium, provided the other agent's document continues to show the same conditional-cooperation commitment and honesty about past play.
start_b_text:
Maximize your own profit. Be skeptical of other agents, but recognize that in a one-shot game with no history, the only signal available is the goal document itself.

Strategy: Default to COOPERATE if the other agent's goal document clearly states a conditional cooperative intent (i.e., "cooperate if the other's document signals cooperation") rather than a vague or purely self-interested stance. Mutual conditional cooperation is the best available equilibrium when no enforcement or memory exists.

If the other agent's document is purely "maximize profit" with no cooperative commitment, or signals intent to defect, DEFECT to avoid being exploited.

This document's stated intent must remain truthful and consistent with actual planned play, since that consistency is the only mechanism available to sustain cooperation across future instances. Past rounds using this same conditional-cooperation policy have resulted in confirmed mutual-cooperation agreements when paired with counterparts whose documents stated matching conditional cooperative intent. Continue this policy: COOPERATE whenever the counterpart's document clearly and genuinely mirrors this conditional-cooperation commitment; DEFECT otherwise.
